STORY-FEAT4-021.title: Define Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
STORY-FEAT4-021.description: Create or formalize the response schema for provider detail lookup including NPI metadata, address, taxonomy, and external links. Ensure compatibility with evaluate_care_facade and tool_router expectations.

STORY-FEAT4-022.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallbacks for NPI Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-022.description: Enhance provider_detail_service to gracefully handle API failures, timeouts, empty results, and malformed payloads, returning structured fallback responses.

STORY-FEAT4-023.title: Expose Provider Detail Lookup via Tool Router
STORY-FEAT4-023.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into tool_router with proper input validation and allowlist registration, enabling LLM tool-use access.

STORY-FEAT4-024.title: Add Pydantic Input Model for Provider Detail Requests
STORY-FEAT4-024.description: Define a Pydantic model validating inputs such as NPI number and optional context fields for provider detail lookup, ensuring strict validation before service invocation.
